notes: Canonical s&box MCP transports on VENGEANCE. Claude Bridge uses file IPC — it does NOT bind HTTP :29015. jtc owns HTTP :29015/mcp. chomnr owns HTTP :9090/sbox-mcp.

jtc.hostnameNote: jtc HttpListener binds localhost only — Cursor must use localhost, not 127.0.0.1 (HTTP 400 Invalid Hostname)

blenderBridge.notes: Editor > Blender Bridge panel. Saved ConVar bridge_autostart (default 1). Blender addon Connect on N-panel s&box tab.

portConflictPolicy.claudeBridgeVsJtc: No HTTP conflict — Bridge is file IPC only. get_bridge_status may mention :29015 as npm metadata; ignore for bind checks.
portConflictPolicy.changeChomnrPort: chomnr MCP dock Settings → new port → Install-VengeanceSboxEditorMcp.ps1 -Port N
portConflictPolicy.changeJtcPort: jtc MCP Server dock → edit Port field → Stop/Start → Install-VengeanceSboxEditorMcp.ps1 -JtcPort N
